title: 弹弓抛掷
summary: 沿轨道调值时，离轨不该被夹回一维。拉过离轨阈值，松手按抛体落点改值。
summaryEn: When tuning a value on a track, leaving it should not clamp back to 1-D. Cross the off-track threshold, release, and commit the ballistic landing.
asks: 沿轨道调值时，离轨该夹回一维，还是变成弹弓按落点改值？
asksEn: When tuning a value on a track, should leaving it clamp to 1-D, or become a slingshot that commits the landing?

links.when: 弹弓是离轨抛体改值，不是沿轨位移过门槛承诺
links.whenEn: a sling throw changes a value by landing, it is not an on-track confirm gate

links.when: 落点是轨道上的量化值，不是列表重排或跨组接收
links.whenEn: the landing is a quantized track value, not a list reorder or cross-group receive

links.when: 抛体落地量化不是滚轮吸附基准线
links.whenEn: ballistic landing is not a wheel snapping to a baseline
